processingDialog.content: Live rollout line 10 confirms model gpt-6-astra and effort max, thread 01a1b2d9-8532-7722-b8b0-1483afa0d3b4, CLI 0.167.0. Executed add-profile: one non-skill profile file read fully; eight Global and three Workspace memories loaded through the Codex wrapper, excluding MEMORY-PROCESS-007. Root marker read fully with API value redacted. Reviewer will apply the Z16 addendum: records head 9a261993, code head da11faa2, 61-task snapshot. The old-head clauses are historical where expressly superseded. No builds/tests, no tracked edits, no external mutations except own session log. Infrastructure failures are separate, not score penalties. Rejected alternative: treating prior reviewer PASSes or implementer disclosures as verified current evidence. Initial profile reads used inline PowerShell before the file-script rule was fully loaded; subsequent inspection logic is in analyzed PS1 files.

Evidence decision: the current manifest is the da11faa2 set named by the Z16 addendum, not an older gate set. Independent read-only parsing verified all 34 entries, their bytes and SHA-256 values against the committed blobs, 30 TRX files, zero failed or skipped results, and identical 4866 unit names on Linux and Windows. Retained in hv-ug-r14-trx-audit.json and hv-ug-r14-trx-cases.json. This proves supplied execution results and integrity, not adequacy or environment independence; source, criteria, chronology and individual task review continue. Alternatives rejected: rerunning tests is forbidden by policy 7.9; accepting green counters as proof of adequacy is unsound.
